issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement a function named `_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)` (leading underscore) while both the template and solution define the function as `construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)` (no leading underscore). This name/signature discrepancy can confuse students about which function to implement and may cause test harness mismatches or naming errors. The leading underscore in the problem text also suggests a private/internal function name, which contradicts the public function provided in the template and solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the function name consistent across all artifacts. Either (a) change the problem statement to reference `construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(Hx: npt.NDArray[np.int8], offset: int = 0) -> stim.Circuit`, or (b) rename the template/solution function to `_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)`. Prefer updating the problem statement to remove the leading underscore so it matches the template and solution and avoids implying the function is private.
